title: RAW development and qualification
objective: Finish the qualification of continuous RAW editing for the Nikon Z6, Fujifilm X100VI and DJI Air 2S: controlled quality, the foundation and journey checkpoints, failure hardening, packaging and the whole-editor measurement.
context_summary: Continuous RAW editing is implemented: LibRaw decodes a retained u16 mosaic; Rust normalizes it and scales the planes, and the pinned librtprocess RCD and Markesteijn only demosaic on one refill executor over the shared pool; the DNG GainMap derives its taps once per row and column; one verified source cache with single-flight preparation feeds the renderer and keeps a second development within a 600 MiB budget; the develop FFI boundary is narrow, container parsing is one parser and RAW export is delivered. What remains is the RAW qualification milestone. Decisions: docs/decisions.md; RAW contracts: docs/design/initial-raw.md, raw-integration.md, air2s-dng.md.

tasks.description: Prove a high-precision Bayer/X-Trans development path and neutral defaults on all qualified cameras.
extra_context: RAW qualification milestone on the roadmap, not a wave of the post-consolidation work.
The selected production path uses retained u16 mosaics and LibRaw metadata with float RCD/Markesteijn development. LibRaw processed 8/16-bit RGB remains a comparison input, not the editable source.
The established demosaicers are integrated; controlled quality and resource qualification of that selected path remains open.
Include the supplied DJI FC3411 DNG in precision/development comparison and inspect OpcodeList requirements, DNG calibration, active/default crop and stored precision separately from NEF/RAF.

Exposure is Basic's on every kind (docs/design/source-controls.md): on RAW it multiplies the developed scene-linear planes in Basic's colour stage, and the source development carries white balance only.

Bayer highlight latitude: the pinned RCD clips each gained Bayer site at sensor white before interpolating (`bayer_input_clips_at_sensor_white_after_gain_and_x_trans_does_not`), while X-Trans keeps over-white values. The owner decided on 2026-09-28 (docs/decisions.md, "Plan refresh") to retain the latitude for Bayer, provided the rendering change measured on the supplied Z6 and Air 2S files shows no new highlight artefacts such as false-colour clipped highlights; otherwise the clip stays and docs/design/initial-raw.md documents it as the Bayer path's limit. This task makes the change, measures it on both files and records which way it went; the pinned test and digests change only with it.

Outstanding: the retained float path, full parameter ranges and actual supplied-file render/edit behavior are implemented. Controlled chart, deliberate highlight/shadow, high ISO, fabric/foliage and Fuji DR/shutter coverage remain open. Do not mark this quality gate complete from the current corpus.

tasks.description: Harden RAW source, native worker, cache and recipe failure behavior.
extra_context: RAW qualification milestone on the roadmap, not a wave of the post-consolidation work.
Deterministic bound/error tests belong in CI; latency is measured separately. Do not treat a decoder memory option as a whole-process cap.

Already in place: a panic on the source worker or while the catalog owner serves a message is contained and answered as `internal` (`run_source_task`, `owner_loop`), and the develop boundary catches every C++ exception. The native fault injector covers RCD tile-job faults and, in the ignored owner-file oracle, Markesteijn's; this plan's develop-boundary task moves it out of the production ABI and keeps that coverage.

The source cache keeps a second development within `luxforge_raw::RETAINED_DEVELOPMENT_BYTES`, taken out of the plane gate's count by its `Retention`, and a completed job evicts only for queued work that allocates planes (docs/design/raw-integration.md, "Second development"); the in-flight accounting this task verifies covers both.
Outstanding: deterministic source, metadata, queue, cancellation, provider-loss and shutdown checks are implemented. Native fuzzing/sanitizers and systematic fault-injection coverage remain open.

tasks.description: Verify packaged RAW dependency/resource delivery and automated portability.
extra_context: RAW qualification milestone on the roadmap, not a wave of the post-consolidation work.
Native Windows/Linux desktop verification and manual license/native/asset audits remain deferred. This task covers builds/packages/headless correctness and native M4 packaging.

The bundled adapter and notice inventory are implemented. The bundled RAW build compiles with MSVC, applies its librtprocess changes as a build-time patch (`patches/librtprocess-local.patch`), and the CI workflow (`.github/workflows/check.yml`) runs `verify --tier quick`, a release build and `package` on macos-14, windows-2022 and ubuntu-24.04; a hosted run is headless build and test evidence, not native desktop qualification.

Outstanding: native M4 packaging, static linkage/no external RAW runtime, bundled notices, packaged NEF/RAF edit/reopen and 12 packaged JPEG/background smoke scenarios pass. The hosted Windows/Linux build and package baseline needs a refresh (docs/features.md), and qualification across the target matrix remains open; native M4 evidence does not establish Windows/Linux build or desktop behavior.

tasks.description: Measure full-editor RAW responsiveness, memory and JPEG regressions on the owner's M4.
extra_context: RAW qualification milestone on the roadmap, not a wave of the post-consolidation work.
This measurement is taken after the development executor, the Rust normalization and the second development landed, so the recorded distributions describe the code that ships.
Provisional time/RSS targets are investigation hypotheses until the owner accepts measured budgets. Do not hide misses by changing input modes or quietly enabling embedded previews.

Tools: the RAW editor journey is the `raw-editor` smoke scenario, which records one functional run's request-to-display and capture times per source in `raw-editor-checks.json`, so a distribution is 30 runs of it; RAW memory under a heavy edit is the `performance` scenario's over a RAW `--source`; below the editor, `luxforge-raw`'s ignored release tests `owner_development_timing` (development and DNG corrections) and `bayer_normalization_release_abba_profile` (normalization against demosaic) time the development's own stages. JPEG baselines use editor-performance.

Recorded before waves 1 to 3 (docs/specs/performance.md, "Current RAW and JPEG measurements"): thirty complete native M4 trials per owner camera and four public mode workflows pass; the same 24/60 MP JPEG core diagnostic is recorded before/after; Fuji captured RSS p95 is 1992 MiB with an unexplained 2436 MiB maximum, and screenshot-free peaks are 1583-1647 MiB. Those history rows predate the refill executor, the Rust normalization and the second development.

Current figures, on a shared host: retained-mosaic development p50 is about 184-232 ms on the X100VI, 37-40 ms on the Z6 and 31-34 ms on the Air 2S ("Mosaic normalization"); a switch whose development the second slot holds displays in about 20 ms p50 on the X100VI and Air 2S and about 32 ms on the Z6, and holding both developments adds 230 to 458 MiB of RSS, the X100VI's edit launch reaching 2290 / 2352 MiB p50 / p95 over the switch window ("Second development"). A redevelopment's peak also holds the retained development. Fine-grained stage/GPU/cancellation/idle attribution and an accepted budget remain open.

The owner decided the RAW memory budget on 2026-09-28 (docs/decisions.md, "Plan refresh"): the one-development working set keeps its 1.5 GiB CPU-RSS investigation target until this measurement attributes today's miss, and the retained second development has its own 600 MiB byte budget (`luxforge_raw::RETAINED_DEVELOPMENT_BYTES`), with GPU memory reported separately. Only this task's numbers count against it; if a measured total is unacceptable, propose a higher target, a smaller slot or a proxy-only compare. This task's M4 RSS measurement is also the one the second-development decision names before any byte-budgeted source cache that keeps JPEG decodes beside the RAW developments, and the GPU residency measurement beyond the photo-texture ceiling runs beside it.

Measurement depends on the implemented editor, not on completion of broad controlled-scene/fuzz/portability gates. Those gates remain independently open. RSS sampling includes renderer/capture effects and must not be relabelled as isolated CPU heap or GPU memory.
